meta.cycle: isa-max-a task-7 (C-A.4 0x39/0x3c formalization + C-A.5 cmp38-self pre-sweep)
meta.method: raw def-use over every strict corpus site per (section, op, lo11) row of BOTH maps; def-use framework imported from h16_reform (T6: single source of the semantics); per-op const value check against the candidate formula; cmp38-self: linear cc0a consumer scan over every rs==rt sel0 site (strict and non-strict, fail-closed)
meta.verdict_rule: H-39-lo-consistent/H-3c-zero-consistent iff the row has strict sites and no const value-check mismatch; silent (None) when no strict sites; conflict=True on a mismatch (the FW tests a constant the candidate formula does not compute)
meta.static_rule_note: consistent = NO raw def-use contradiction detected (absence-of-contradiction signal, not positive corroboration); the positive static evidence is counted separately (const-test consumers + adjudicable value checks in def_use: 14 const-test consumers corpus-wide, 1 adjudicable value checks; 0x39 has NO adjudicable pair in this corpus -- consistency-only leg; 0x3c carries 10 cmp0 const-test consumers, the positive zero-write corroboration)

0x39.note: lo-passthrough: the low 32 bits of rs pass to rd (live vectors are in-place rd==rs); lo11-independent (live unique at lo11 0x000 and 0x7ff)

0x3c.note: zero-write; lo11-independent (the 0x7ff live point killed H-3c-and-lo11; lo11=000 stays live-multi zero|and-lo11 -- both predict 0 there)

cmp38_self.merged_semantics: cmp.w (0x38 sel=0, slaspec 4f4f7b3): CMPRES = (RSlosrc == RTlosrc); consumers b.t/b.f cc=0x0a; cc0a writers: any 0x36 + 0x38 sel0
cmp38_self.fail_closed_note: non-strict (mask-only) sites are scanned with the same code and their raw readings count toward the aggregate (mask-only is never proof in either direction); the strict view is reported separately in the aggregate (strict_sites/strict_insensitive)
cmp38_self.linear_model_note: linear stream scan (no reachability offline): a branch between the site and its linear consumer may divert execution; precedent: the h36/T4 def-use windows are linear too. A no-consumer reading is insensitive under this model.

ceiling: 0x39: no adjudicable const-chain pair exists in this corpus (the single cmpC consumer has non-const provenance) -- the 0x39 static leg is consistency-only; positive lo-passthrough evidence remains live-only (double-live at lo11 0x000/0x7ff)
0x3c: 10 cmp0 const-test consumers (1 adjudicable match: proven rs const, consumer tests 0); no cmpC-nonzero adjudicable pair corroborates the competing H-3c-and-lo11 anywhere in the corpus

PCI/ACE bulk (0x39 330 / 0x3c 158 strict sites outside MAIN): dataflow shapes only (read/clobber/dead/rd-zero) -- no semantic adjudication offline, rows stay consistency-silent-with-sites outside MAIN
cmp38-self: the aggregate is the T8 rule input; the sensitive strict sites (live b.t cmpres consumers) are listed with coordinates in phases.A.cmp38_self.sites
meta.addressing_note: dc offsets only; no dc<->rt base arithmetic needed (per-section param0 bases live in corpus_sections.json)
